CLASS STACK
  Constructor()
    array <- EMPTY LIST
    top <- -1

  FUNCTION PUSH ACCEPTS(element)
    top <- top + 1
    array[top] <- element

  FUNCTION POP ACCEPTS()
    IF top == -1 THEN
      RETURN NULL
    END IF
    element <- array[top]
    top <- top - 1
    RETURN element

  FUNCTION PEEK ACCEPTS()
    IF top == -1 THEN
      RETURN NULL
    END IF
    RETURN array[top]

END CLASS
